MEMORANDUM IN SUPPORT OF PLAINTIFF’S MOTION FOR LEAVE
TO FILE NOTICE OF SUBSEQUENT RECORD DEVELOPMENT

Plaintiff seeks leave to place one subsequent development before the Court in connection
with his pending Rule 72(a) Objections. ECF No. 66. The objections challenge, among other
matters, the requirement in ECF No. 64 that Plaintiff provide a redlined comparison of the
proposed Second Amended and Supplemental Complaint. Local Civil Rule 7(F)(1) requires leave
for further written communications.

On September 18, 2026, Defendants Katie Hall and NCMEC filed ECF No. 74. It states:

“[D]espite numerous efforts, undersigned counsel has been unable to ‘reverse-
engineer’ a redline comparison of the two documents via either Adobe or Word.”

Case 1:26-cv-02331-RDA-IDD Document 77 Filed 09/18/26 Page 2 of 3 PagelD# 775

ECF No. 74 at 4. ECF No. 74 also states that “the format of the factual allegations have
changed.” ECF No. 74 at 5. Both statements postdate ECF No. 66. Both concern the comparison
requirement the objections present for review.

The attached Notice places that development before the Court. The Notice seeks no relief

beyond ECF No. 66 and adds no ground to the objections. Leave should be granted.

Date: September 18, 2026 Respectfully submitted,
